text:
Alex Chen: quick sync — proposing a small scope to ship an Operator Portal + packaging changes so customers can self-manage VPC/on-prem networking and do safe upgrades without operator intervention. link: https://redwood.internal/rd/privdeploy-portal-draft :mag_right:
Mira Patel: high level ok. can you list concrete pieces we need to deliver for an initial ship?
Alex Chen: sure. proposal (concise):
- operator portal UI: claim networks, view peering state, toggle 'network-preserve' for upgrades
- packaging: manifest v2 -> explicit network stanza + trust anchors
- delta installer: apply upgrade patches that avoid IP/route churn (zero-touch where possible)
- rollout model: dedicated-only canary -> pilot tenants -> org-wide
- telemetry + alerts: net-change audit trail, rollback hooks
Samir Gupta: adding context from field: ACME and BetaBank asked for BGP session import/export and ip-preservation during bundle upgrades. they also want config-as-code so their netops can review diffs. this should shape the API surface.
Kyle Roberts: ops constraints: we can’t open to multitenant initially — routing edge cases are nasty. recommend dedicated-only first and a portal toggle to opt into testing.
Alex Chen: agree. prioritize: 1) manifest v2 schema + validation 2) portal read-only view 3) delta installer prototype 4) portal claim/write flows (pilot)
Ops Bot: installer-ci: net-preserve e2e build #482 passed on staging. snippets:
```
network:
  mode: customer-managed
  preserve_ips: true
  bgp:
    enabled: true
    import_policy: ["peer-1","peer-2"]
```
Mira Patel: launch criteria proposal: docs + runbook, 2 pilots signed (one on-prem, one VPC), installer e2e green, RBAC for portal, and a rollback playbook. agree? :thinking_face:
Samir Gupta: :thumbsup: but add support SLA escalation path — field will need 24/7 during pilot window. also we need a quick checklist for netops to approve the manifest diff.
Kyle Roberts: mitigation for risk: limit initial rollout to dedicated single-tenant pools and enforce route-validation in the installer. we can add tenant-mapping later.
Alex Chen: action items:
- Alex: produce manifest v2 spec draft (by EOW)
- Mira: owner for runbook + docs (assign?)
- Samir: draft netops approval checklist + pilot customers (start outreach)
- Kyle: define rollout constraints and canary policy
Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree, or drop comments inline on the doc. will schedule 30m follow-up Q1 next week.
